changelog: Target File Size Quality Solver: Iterative binary-search quality solver strictly hitting desired KB ceilings for image outputs
Watermark & Text Overlay: Full customizable text watermarks with position anchoring, size scaling, and color presets
Canvas Orientation & Alpha Fill: Horizontal/Vertical flip transforms and solid background composites for alpha channels
Expanded Video Containers & Codecs: Full support for MP4, MOV, MKV, WebM, AVI, and GIF across H.264, H.265, VP9, and AV1
Audio Stream Remixing & Volume: 0-200% volume scaling, mono/stereo downmixing, and multi-codec support (AAC, MP3, Opus, FLAC)
Desktop Studio Modernization: Drag-and-drop ingestion cards, comparative inspection badges, and instant file reveal actions
